# Functions unreachable from core/cmd/app that are kept on purpose: the public ORM
# API offered to modules (framework surface) and test support (internal/testdb, the
# schema helpers it calls, App.Handler for in-process HTTP tests).
# CI fails when deadcode reports anything NOT listed here — delete the new dead
# code, or add it here if it is deliberate public API. Regenerate with:
#   cd core && deadcode -f '{{range .Funcs}}{{$.Path}}.{{.Name}}{{"\n"}}{{end}}' ./... | sort

# Handler.check validates one write on any orm.Executor. Its caller (the .gan
# importer) lands later in this epic, so nothing reachable from main uses it yet.
core/modules/project.Handler.check
# Exchange layer (WP2 to WP3): the neutral Plan model, the .gan adapter, the loader
# and export (WP3 Tasks 4 and 6) and the diff (WP3 Task 5). diffPlans is the preview
# the wizard reads, removalDependents the count shown on a removal row and exportPlan
# the plan the export writes; the routes and the importer that call them
# (loadPlan, planHash, formatByKey, Handler.check) land in WP4 Task 8. deadcode
# measures reachability from main, so until WP4 puts a route on top of this subtree
# every one of its functions reads as dead, including workdaysBetween, endAfter and
# Weekend.worked even though Tasks 4 and 5 gave the first two real callers. Each name
# is listed rather than covered by a wildcard so that a function dropped from the
# design shows up as a stale entry.
